messages:
jen: getting reports from viewers of 'no video' and captions ~25s behind. leadership audio OK. @video-team any status? :rotating_light:
mark: looking at encoder enc-5, saw packet loss spikes to ingest. pulling a short tail of logs now.
mark: ```enc-5 WARN: rtt=240ms pkt_loss=3%
enc-5 ERROR: reconnect attempt 1 failed```
priya: can we route the NDI feed to the spare encoder and keep audio live? Gabe, can you bring spare online?
gabe: booting spare encoder now. will re-route in ~20s. also requested cam SDs from stage ops as a backup.
ops-bot: Incident created IN-2026-101: all-hands partial video outage -> paging video-team.
emma: starting laptop capture as precaution: `obs-cli --profile=allhands_emergency --startrecording` writing to /var/tmp/allhands_emergency.mkv
zach: captions pipeline showing backlog; restarting captions-worker to drain queues.
nina: stage ops update: cam-2 dropped due to switcher PSU glitch at 09:41. swapping PSU and testing (ETA ~3m).
mark: re-routing in 5...4...3... switched NDI -> spare-enc-02. monitoring bitrates.
mark: spare accepted stream, bitrate normalizing. can people confirm video frame on their end? :eyes:
jen: posted a slide "Technical interruption — continuing Q&A (captions delayed)" and pinged attendees.
gabe: cam-2 SD retrieved from stage, copying to s3://allhands-raw/1850012345/cam2/ (upload in progress).
emma: local capture confirmed writing, file size increasing. will upload when stable.
leo: once SD upload finishes I'll stitch emma's local + cam2 for the missing segments and produce a ~2min clip for product. ETA 15-25m.
priya: follow-ups: - enable automatic local-capture for all-hands - autoscale captions workers or add backpressure alerts - add a lightweight health overlay ("last keyframe Xs") for encoder UI.
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-88 "Enable auto local-capture for all-hands" assigned to ops.
ops-bot: Action logged: TICKET-ALLHANDS-89 "Autoscale captions workers" assigned to infra.
mark: noted encoder firmware on spare needs a patch; scheduling maintenance window. logs uploaded: s3://infra-logs/allhands/1850012345/encoder.log (video-team access granted).
nina: PSU swapped, cam-2 green on switcher, performing a brief stress test.
jen: thanks team — great quick swap. i'll add these to the postmortem agenda and notify product about the clip once leo uploads.
gabe: uploaded cam-2 files to s3; checksum OK.
leo: stitched clip uploaded -> https://storage.redwood.ai/allhands/1850012345/stitch-clip.mp4 and short timeline notes.
jen: received clip, filing follow-ups and closing thread after docs updated. :white_check_mark:
